senses.gloss: m. pl. (prob. a nom. gentil., from a trading station named אוונכר, a compound of אוונא [a. אִכָּר?]; cmp. אֲוָנָא) Avankreans (?), traders.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 30a:8">Succ. 30ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 30b:2">30ᵇ</cite>. [Ar. identifies our w. with <cite ref="A01675"><he>אַכְוַנְגַּר</he></cite> which is not in agreement with the context.]
